curid:45370811.title: Chinese Kids at the Tjap-Gomeh Festival in Makassar WDL2896
curid:45370811.description: This photograph shows Chinese children participating in the Tjap Go Meh Festival in Makassar, the largest city on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi. curid:31396479.title: A Flood on Java WDL2905
curid:31396479.description: This view, showing people on a raft in a flooded river in central Java's Jawa Tengah province is the work of Raden Saleh (1807-80), who is regarded by many scholars as the first modern artist from the Dutch East Indies. Saleh was born into a noble Javanese family and studied with a Belgian artist in the west Javan city of Bogor before going to study in the Netherlands. He spent 20 years in Europe

curid:45370988.title: Pendopo of the Palace of the Mangkoenagoro of Surakarta WDL2898
curid:45370988.description: This photograph shows the pendopo of the palace of the Mangkunegaran dynasty in Surakarta. The pendopo, a large open-air pavilion built on columns, is a crucial element of Javanese architecture. It is open on all sides and provides shelter from sun and rain, but allows breezes to enter.
